idempotency_key.description:
A client-supplied, universally unique identifier (UUID) for the
request.

See [Idempotency](https://developer.squareup.com/docs/build-basics/common-api-patterns/idempotency) in the
[API Development 101](https://developer.squareup.com/docs/buildbasics) section for more
information.

changes.description:
The set of physical counts and inventory adjustments to be made.
Changes are applied based on the client-supplied timestamp and may be sent
out of order.

ignore_unchanged_counts.description:
Indicates whether the current physical count should be ignored if
the quantity is unchanged since the last physical count. Default: `true`.

CatalogMeasurementUnit.description:
Represents the unit used to measure a `CatalogItemVariation` and
specifies the precision for decimal quantities.

measurement_unit.description: Indicates the unit used to measure the quantity of a catalog item variation.

precision.description:
An integer between 0 and 5 that represents the maximum number of
positions allowed after the decimal in quantities measured with this unit.
For example:

- if the precision is 0, the quantity can be 1, 2, 3, etc.
- if the precision is 1, the quantity can be 0.1, 0.2, etc.
- if the precision is 2, the quantity can be 0.01, 0.12, etc.

Default: 3

Currency.description:
Indicates the associated currency for an amount of money. Values correspond
to [ISO 4217](https://wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217).

InventoryAdjustment.description:
Represents a change in state or quantity of product inventory at a
particular time and location.

id.description:
A unique ID generated by Square for the
`InventoryAdjustment`.

reference_id.description:
An optional ID provided by the application to tie the
`InventoryAdjustment` to an external
system.

from_state.description:
The [inventory state](entity:InventoryState) of the related quantity
of items before the adjustment.
See [InventoryState](#type-inventorystate) for possible values

to_state.description:
The [inventory state](entity:InventoryState) of the related quantity
of items after the adjustment.
See [InventoryState](#type-inventorystate) for possible values

location_id.description:
The Square-generated ID of the [Location](entity:Location) where the related
quantity of items is being tracked.

catalog_object_id.description:
The Square-generated ID of the
[CatalogObject](entity:CatalogObject) being tracked.

catalog_object_type.description:
The [type](entity:CatalogObjectType) of the [CatalogObject](entity:CatalogObject) being tracked. 

The Inventory API supports setting and reading the `"catalog_object_type": "ITEM_VARIATION"` field value. 
In addition, it can also read the `"catalog_object_type": "ITEM"` field value that is set by the Square Restaurants app.

quantity.description:
The number of items affected by the adjustment as a decimal string.
Can support up to 5 digits after the decimal point.

total_price_money.description:
The total price paid for goods associated with the
adjustment. Present if and only if `to_state` is `SOLD`. Always
non-negative.

occurred_at.description:
A client-generated RFC 3339-formatted timestamp that indicates when
the inventory adjustment took place. For inventory adjustment updates, the `occurred_at`
timestamp cannot be older than 24 hours or in the future relative to the
time of the request.

created_at.description: An RFC 3339-formatted timestamp that indicates when the inventory adjustment is received.

source.description:
Information about the application that caused the
inventory adjustment.

employee_id.description:
The Square-generated ID of the [Employee](entity:Employee) responsible for the
inventory adjustment.

team_member_id.description:
The Square-generated ID of the [Team Member](entity:TeamMember) responsible for the
inventory adjustment.

transaction_id.description:
The Square-generated ID of the [Transaction](entity:Transaction) that
caused the adjustment. Only relevant for payment-related state
transitions.

refund_id.description:
The Square-generated ID of the [Refund](entity:Refund) that
caused the adjustment. Only relevant for refund-related state
transitions.

purchase_order_id.description:
The Square-generated ID of the purchase order that caused the
adjustment. Only relevant for state transitions from the Square for Retail
app.

goods_receipt_id.description:
The Square-generated ID of the goods receipt that caused the
adjustment. Only relevant for state transitions from the Square for Retail
app.

adjustment_group.description: An adjustment group bundling the related adjustments of item variations through stock conversions in a single inventory event.

id.description:
A unique ID generated by Square for the
`InventoryAdjustmentGroup`.

root_adjustment_id.description: The inventory adjustment of the composed variation.

from_state.description:
Representative `from_state` for adjustments within the group. For example, for a group adjustment from `IN_STOCK` to `SOLD`,
there can be two component adjustments in the group: one from `IN_STOCK`to `COMPOSED` and the other one from `COMPOSED` to `SOLD`.
Here, the representative `from_state` for the `InventoryAdjustmentGroup` is `IN_STOCK`.
See [InventoryState](#type-inventorystate) for possible values

to_state.description:
Representative `to_state` for adjustments within group. For example, for a group adjustment from `IN_STOCK` to `SOLD`,
the two component adjustments in the group can be from `IN_STOCK` to `COMPOSED` and from `COMPOSED` to `SOLD`.
Here, the representative `to_state` of the `InventoryAdjustmentGroup` is `SOLD`.
See [InventoryState](#type-inventorystate) for possible values

InventoryChange.description:
Represents a single physical count, inventory, adjustment, or transfer
that is part of the history of inventory changes for a particular
[CatalogObject](entity:CatalogObject) instance.

type.description:
Indicates how the inventory change is applied. See
[InventoryChangeType](entity:InventoryChangeType) for all possible values.
See [InventoryChangeType](#type-inventorychangetype) for possible values

physical_count.description:
Contains details about the physical count when `type` is
`PHYSICAL_COUNT`, and is unset for all other change types.

adjustment.description:
Contains details about the inventory adjustment when `type` is
`ADJUSTMENT`, and is unset for all other change types.

transfer.description:
Contains details about the inventory transfer when `type` is
`TRANSFER`, and is unset for all other change types.

_Note:_ An [InventoryTransfer](entity:InventoryTransfer) object can only be set in the input to the
[BatchChangeInventory](api-endpoint:Inventory-BatchChangeInventory) endpoint when the seller has an active Retail Plus subscription.

measurement_unit.description: The [CatalogMeasurementUnit](entity:CatalogMeasurementUnit) object representing the catalog measurement unit associated with the inventory change.

measurement_unit_id.description: The ID of the [CatalogMeasurementUnit](entity:CatalogMeasurementUnit) object representing the catalog measurement unit associated with the inventory change.

x-enum-elements.name: PHYSICAL_COUNT
x-enum-elements.description: The change occurred as part of a physical count update.

x-enum-elements.name: ADJUSTMENT
x-enum-elements.description:
The change occurred as part of the normal lifecycle of goods
(e.g., as an inventory adjustment).

x-enum-elements.name: TRANSFER
x-enum-elements.description: The change occurred as part of an inventory transfer.

InventoryChangeType.description: Indicates how the inventory change was applied to a tracked product quantity.

InventoryPhysicalCount.description:
Represents the quantity of an item variation that is physically present
at a specific location, verified by a seller or a seller's employee. For example,
a physical count might come from an employee counting the item variations on
hand or from syncing with an external system.

id.description:
A unique Square-generated ID for the
[InventoryPhysicalCount](entity:InventoryPhysicalCount).

reference_id.description:
An optional ID provided by the application to tie the
[InventoryPhysicalCount](entity:InventoryPhysicalCount) to an external
system.

catalog_object_id.description:
The Square-generated ID of the
[CatalogObject](entity:CatalogObject) being tracked.

catalog_object_type.description:
The [type](entity:CatalogObjectType) of the [CatalogObject](entity:CatalogObject) being tracked. 

The Inventory API supports setting and reading the `"catalog_object_type": "ITEM_VARIATION"` field value. 
In addition, it can also read the `"catalog_object_type": "ITEM"` field value that is set by the Square Restaurants app.

state.description:
The current [inventory state](entity:InventoryState) for the related
quantity of items.
See [InventoryState](#type-inventorystate) for possible values

location_id.description:
The Square-generated ID of the [Location](entity:Location) where the related
quantity of items is being tracked.

quantity.description:
The number of items affected by the physical count as a decimal string.
The number can support up to 5 digits after the decimal point.

source.description:
Information about the application with which the
physical count is submitted.

employee_id.description:
The Square-generated ID of the [Employee](entity:Employee) responsible for the
physical count.

team_member_id.description:
The Square-generated ID of the [Team Member](entity:TeamMember) responsible for the
physical count.

occurred_at.description:
A client-generated RFC 3339-formatted timestamp that indicates when
the physical count was examined. For physical count updates, the `occurred_at`
timestamp cannot be older than 24 hours or in the future relative to the
time of the request.

created_at.description: An RFC 3339-formatted timestamp that indicates when the physical count is received.

x-enum-elements.name: CUSTOM
x-enum-elements.description:
The related quantity of items are in a custom state. **READ-ONLY**:
the Inventory API cannot move quantities to or from this state.

x-enum-elements.name: IN_STOCK
x-enum-elements.description: The related quantity of items are on hand and available for sale.

x-enum-elements.name: SOLD
x-enum-elements.description:
The related quantity of items were sold as part of an itemized
transaction. Quantities in the `SOLD` state are no longer tracked.

x-enum-elements.name: RETURNED_BY_CUSTOMER
x-enum-elements.description:
The related quantity of items were returned through the Square Point
of Sale application, but are not yet available for sale. **READ-ONLY**:
the Inventory API cannot move quantities to or from this state.

x-enum-elements.name: RESERVED_FOR_SALE
x-enum-elements.description:
The related quantity of items are on hand, but not currently
available for sale. **READ-ONLY**: the Inventory API cannot move
quantities to or from this state.

x-enum-elements.name: SOLD_ONLINE
x-enum-elements.description:
The related quantity of items were sold online. **READ-ONLY**: the
Inventory API cannot move quantities to or from this state.

x-enum-elements.name: ORDERED_FROM_VENDOR
x-enum-elements.description:
The related quantity of items were ordered from a vendor but not yet
received. **READ-ONLY**: the Inventory API cannot move quantities to or
from this state.

x-enum-elements.name: RECEIVED_FROM_VENDOR
x-enum-elements.description:
The related quantity of items were received from a vendor but are
not yet available for sale. **READ-ONLY**: the Inventory API cannot move
quantities to or from this state.

x-enum-elements.name: IN_TRANSIT_TO
x-enum-elements.description:
Replaced by `IN_TRANSIT` to represent quantities
of items that are in transit between locations.

x-enum-elements.name: NONE
x-enum-elements.description:
A placeholder indicating that the related quantity of items are not
currently tracked in Square. Transferring quantities from the `NONE` state
to a tracked state (e.g., `IN_STOCK`) introduces stock into the system.

x-enum-elements.name: WASTE
x-enum-elements.description:
The related quantity of items are lost or damaged and cannot be
sold.

x-enum-elements.name: UNLINKED_RETURN
x-enum-elements.description:
The related quantity of items were returned but not linked to a
previous transaction. Unlinked returns are not tracked in Square.
Transferring a quantity from `UNLINKED_RETURN` to a tracked state (e.g.,
`IN_STOCK`) introduces new stock into the system.

x-enum-elements.name: COMPOSED
x-enum-elements.description: The related quantity of items that are part of a composition consisting one or more components.

x-enum-elements.name: DECOMPOSED
x-enum-elements.description: The related quantity of items that are part of a component.

x-enum-elements.name: SUPPORTED_BY_NEWER_VERSION
x-enum-elements.description: This state is not supported by this version of the Square API. We recommend that you upgrade the client to use the appropriate version of the Square API supporting this state.

x-enum-elements.name: IN_TRANSIT
x-enum-elements.description: The related quantity of items are in transit between locations. **READ-ONLY:** the Inventory API cannot currently be used to move quantities to or from this inventory state.

InventoryState.description: Indicates the state of a tracked item quantity in the lifecycle of goods.

InventoryTransfer.description:
Represents the transfer of a quantity of product inventory at a
particular time from one location to another.

id.description:
A unique ID generated by Square for the
`InventoryTransfer`.

reference_id.description:
An optional ID provided by the application to tie the
`InventoryTransfer` to an external system.

state.description:
The [inventory state](entity:InventoryState) for the quantity of
items being transferred.
See [InventoryState](#type-inventorystate) for possible values

from_location_id.description:
The Square-generated ID of the [Location](entity:Location) where the related
quantity of items was tracked before the transfer.

to_location_id.description:
The Square-generated ID of the [Location](entity:Location) where the related
quantity of items was tracked after the transfer.

catalog_object_id.description:
The Square-generated ID of the
[CatalogObject](entity:CatalogObject) being tracked.

catalog_object_type.description:
The [type](entity:CatalogObjectType) of the [CatalogObject](entity:CatalogObject) being tracked. 

The Inventory API supports setting and reading the `"catalog_object_type": "ITEM_VARIATION"` field value. 
In addition, it can also read the `"catalog_object_type": "ITEM"` field value that is set by the Square Restaurants app.

quantity.description:
The number of items affected by the transfer as a decimal string.
Can support up to 5 digits after the decimal point.

occurred_at.description:
A client-generated RFC 3339-formatted timestamp that indicates when
the transfer took place. For write actions, the `occurred_at` timestamp
cannot be older than 24 hours or in the future relative to the time of the
request.

created_at.description:
An RFC 3339-formatted timestamp that indicates when Square
received the transfer request.

source.description:
Information about the application that initiated the
inventory transfer.

employee_id.description:
The Square-generated ID of the [Employee](entity:Employee) responsible for the
inventory transfer.

team_member_id.description:
The Square-generated ID of the [Team Member](entity:TeamMember) responsible for the
inventory transfer.

MeasurementUnit.description:
Represents a unit of measurement to use with a quantity, such as ounces
or inches. Exactly one of the following fields are required: `custom_unit`,
`area_unit`, `length_unit`, `volume_unit`, and `weight_unit`.

custom_unit.description:
A custom unit of measurement defined by the seller using the Point of Sale
app or ad-hoc as an order line item.

area_unit.description:
Represents a standard area unit.
See [MeasurementUnitArea](#type-measurementunitarea) for possible values

length_unit.description:
Represents a standard length unit.
See [MeasurementUnitLength](#type-measurementunitlength) for possible values

volume_unit.description:
Represents a standard volume unit.
See [MeasurementUnitVolume](#type-measurementunitvolume) for possible values

weight_unit.description:
Represents a standard unit of weight or mass.
See [MeasurementUnitWeight](#type-measurementunitweight) for possible values

generic_unit.description:
Reserved for API integrations that lack the ability to specify a real measurement unit
See [MeasurementUnitGeneric](#type-measurementunitgeneric) for possible values

time_unit.description:
Represents a standard unit of time.
See [MeasurementUnitTime](#type-measurementunittime) for possible values

type.description:
Represents the type of the measurement unit.
See [MeasurementUnitUnitType](#type-measurementunitunittype) for possible values

x-enum-elements.name: IMPERIAL_ACRE
x-enum-elements.description: The area is measured in acres.

x-enum-elements.name: IMPERIAL_SQUARE_INCH
x-enum-elements.description: The area is measured in square inches.

x-enum-elements.name: IMPERIAL_SQUARE_FOOT
x-enum-elements.description: The area is measured in square feet.

x-enum-elements.name: IMPERIAL_SQUARE_YARD
x-enum-elements.description: The area is measured in square yards.

x-enum-elements.name: IMPERIAL_SQUARE_MILE
x-enum-elements.description: The area is measured in square miles.

x-enum-elements.name: METRIC_SQUARE_CENTIMETER
x-enum-elements.description: The area is measured in square centimeters.

x-enum-elements.name: METRIC_SQUARE_METER
x-enum-elements.description: The area is measured in square meters.

x-enum-elements.name: METRIC_SQUARE_KILOMETER
x-enum-elements.description: The area is measured in square kilometers.

MeasurementUnitArea.description: Unit of area used to measure a quantity.

MeasurementUnitCustom.description: The information needed to define a custom unit, provided by the seller.

name.description: The name of the custom unit, for example "bushel".

abbreviation.description:
The abbreviation of the custom unit, such as "bsh" (bushel). This appears
in the cart for the Point of Sale app, and in reports.

x-enum-elements.name: IMPERIAL_INCH
x-enum-elements.description: The length is measured in inches.

x-enum-elements.name: IMPERIAL_FOOT
x-enum-elements.description: The length is measured in feet.

x-enum-elements.name: IMPERIAL_YARD
x-enum-elements.description: The length is measured in yards.

x-enum-elements.name: IMPERIAL_MILE
x-enum-elements.description: The length is measured in miles.

x-enum-elements.name: METRIC_MILLIMETER

x-enum-elements.name: METRIC_CENTIMETER
x-enum-elements.description: The length is measured in centimeters.

x-enum-elements.name: METRIC_METER
x-enum-elements.description: The length is measured in meters.

x-enum-elements.name: METRIC_KILOMETER
x-enum-elements.description: The length is measured in kilometers.

MeasurementUnitLength.description: The unit of length used to measure a quantity.

x-enum-elements.name: GENERIC_MILLISECOND
x-enum-elements.description: The time is measured in milliseconds.

x-enum-elements.name: GENERIC_SECOND
x-enum-elements.description: The time is measured in seconds.

x-enum-elements.name: GENERIC_MINUTE
x-enum-elements.description: The time is measured in minutes.

x-enum-elements.name: GENERIC_HOUR
x-enum-elements.description: The time is measured in hours.

x-enum-elements.name: GENERIC_DAY
x-enum-elements.description: The time is measured in days.

MeasurementUnitTime.description: Unit of time used to measure a quantity (a duration).

x-enum-elements.name: TYPE_CUSTOM
x-enum-elements.description: The unit details are contained in the custom_unit field.

x-enum-elements.name: TYPE_AREA

x-enum-elements.name: TYPE_LENGTH

x-enum-elements.name: TYPE_VOLUME

Money.description:
Represents an amount of money. `Money` fields can be signed or unsigned.
Fields that do not explicitly define whether they are signed or unsigned are
considered unsigned and can only hold positive amounts. For signed fields, the
sign of the value indicates the purpose of the money transfer. See
[Working with Monetary Amounts](https://developer.squareup.com/docs/build-basics/working-with-monetary-amounts)
for more information.

amount.description:
The amount of money, in the smallest denomination of the currency
indicated by `currency`. For example, when `currency` is `USD`, `amount` is
in cents. Monetary amounts can be positive or negative. See the specific
field description to determine the meaning of the sign in a particular case.

currency.description:
The type of currency, in __ISO 4217 format__. For example, the currency
code for US dollars is `USD`.

See [Currency](entity:Currency) for possible values.
See [Currency](#type-currency) for possible values

x-enum-elements.name: EXTERNAL_API
x-enum-elements.description: Square Connect APIs (for example, Orders API or Checkout API).

x-enum-elements.name: OTHER
x-enum-elements.description: A Square product that does not match any other value.

Product.description: Indicates the Square product used to generate a change.

SourceApplication.description: Represents information about the application used to generate a change.

product.description:
__Read only__ The [product](entity:Product) type of the application.
See [Product](#type-product) for possible values

application_id.description:
__Read only__ The Square-assigned ID of the application. This field is used only if the
[product](entity:Product) type is `EXTERNAL_API`.

name.description:
__Read only__ The display name of the application
(for example, `"Custom Application"` or `"Square POS 4.74 for Android"`).
